titre: Dupixent, le marché visé par Apogee
sous_titre: Ventes annuelles mondiales, en millions d'euros, 2022 à 2025

2022.texte: Sales grew to €42,997 million driven by Dupixent (€8,293 million, +43.8%)

2023.texte: In 2023, Dupixent sales reached €10,715 million, up 34.0%.

2024.texte: In FY 2024, Dupixent sales were €13,072 million and increased by 23.1%

2025.texte: In FY 2025, sales were €15,714 million and increased by 25.2%
